d: Bihar ke vaishali jile ke hajipurmen bekhauph apradhiyon aur parivarik vivad ke chalte golibari ki ek behad sanasnikhej vardat samne aaee hai. hajipur ke sadar thana kshetr antargat adalpur ganv men ek 19 varshiy mahila (sonu kumar ki patni divani kumari) ko sandigdh paristhitiyon men pet men goli mar di gaee. ganbhir rup se ghayal mahila ko parijnon dvara turant hajipur sadar aspatal le jaya gaya, jahan sthiti najuk dekhte hue prathmik upchar ke bad doktaron ne use patna ke piemsiech (PMCH) rephar kar diya hai. vardat ki suchna milte hi pulis mahakme men harkanp mach gaya hai aur vaishali…
